title: Grandma Carter's Yellow Cake

items.body: Preheat the oven to 350 °F (177 °C). Grease the pan.
In a bowl, mix the dry cake mix, melted butter and egg into a thick dough. Press it evenly over the bottom of the pan.
In the stand mixer with the paddle, beat the cream cheese until smooth. Add the powdered sugar and eggs and mix until smooth. Pour this over the crust in the pan and spread it to the edges.
Bake until the top is golden and the center barely jiggles, 35–40 min. Let it cool completely in the pan before cutting, because it firms up as it cools. Cut 4 × 6.

nutritionSource: USDA FoodData Central: SR Legacy (butter, eggs, powdered sugar) and Branded Foods labels (Duncan Hines Classic Yellow, 43 g = 160 kcal, 350 mg, 1 g; Philadelphia).
notes: On the back of the card, to Shelby: “This recipe was give to me by Patra (Madison’s Mom Aunt). She use to bring it to our dinners at Church.”
The card doesn’t name a pan size. 13 × 9 is the usual size for this kind of cake, a gooey butter cake.
Cake mix boxes used to be 18.25 oz and are 15.25 oz now, so the crust comes out a little thinner than it did when she wrote this.
Keep covered in the fridge, because of the cream cheese.
